items.text:
Good game, riddled with bugs and an awful UI.

Half of my hours have been spent on replaying the same savefiles because of dumb bugs (ship rotating on itself forever/station full of NPCs that kill the framerate/route using more fuel than planned in the setting)

but, hey, this game is only FOUR YEARS OLD, it's ok right? I just had to manually debug it myself following reddit guides.

feels good to spend money in a well polished product

EDIT: hey! just found a new bug! what a happy moment! My 60 days gig disappeared, throwing away my last 2 hours spent in travelling...and the target just casually moved to the other side of the system after loading the save again! F**CK THIS GAME

EDIT 2: nice! now there are only Pirates NPCs in OKLG! the station is now completely useless!
items.text_zh:
好游戏，但满是bug和糟糕的UI。

我一半的游戏时间都花在重玩同样的存档上，因为愚蠢的bug（飞船永远自转/空间站满是NPC导致帧率暴跌/路线在设置中消耗的燃料比计划的多）

但是，嘿，这游戏才只有四年历史，没关系对吧？我只需要按照reddit指南自己手动调试。

花钱买一个精心打磨的产品感觉真好

编辑：嘿！刚发现一个新bug！多么快乐的时刻！我60天的任务消失了，扔掉了我最后2小时花在旅行上的时间……而且加载存档后目标就随便移到了星系的另一边！去他妈的这游戏

编辑2：好极了！现在OKLG里只有海盗NPC了！空间站现在完全没用了！
